'''Joe Fox AT-STs in the desert''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Joe Fox]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-6493">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6493 AT-STs in the desert], DeckTech (Joe "JoeCool144" Fox, 9 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6493/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6493/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018172312/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6493/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Fox]]
* '''Published:''' 9 May 2000 (DeckTech)

== Original post ==

'''AT-STs in the desert'''
* '''Author:''' Joe "JoeCool144" Fox
* '''Published:''' May 9, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' AT-STs and drains on Tatooine.

=== Strategy ===

CARD CHANGE There are 63 cards in this deck, I am removing M'iiyoom onith, and 2 Scanning crews.I dont have a lot of time to type, tornado coming. But here is the main strat. Get all the exterior drain two sites in a row with each other. Put the AT-STs in them, use Expand The Empire to make drains more. IF they come to fight react and deploy a lot. Well theres the thunder. C ya
